main_QC: GEO-record feature/mitochondrial gate: 200-2500 features, <=50% mitochondrial counts. Samples require >=50 retained cells for exposure fitting.
sensitivity_QC: 200-6000 features, <=20% mitochondrial counts. Predeclared alternative, not selected by result.
processing_scope: Independent QC and pseudobulk from current attached Cell Ranger gene matrices. No claim of exact author SoupX/DoubletFinder/Seurat reproduction; postprocessing status of attachments not established. FACS labels represent enriched populations, not a proven pure microglial subtype.
sample_identity: Current GEO title, characteristics and sample supplementary filenames; Use verified deposited sample identities. Shared mouse labels across tissues remain eight exposure donors.
